name: CelebrateStudio
author: gianmarieddu

sections.description:
CelebrateStudio is a WordPress plugin for creating narrative-driven celebration websites.

It allows you to build immersive one-page experiences for weddings, birthdays, graduations, anniversaries, and other special events.

Unlike generic page builders, CelebrateStudio is a vertical storytelling system designed specifically for structured emotional event experiences.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the celebrate-studio folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open CelebrateStudio from the WordPress dashboard menu.
  4. Create your personal homepage with our 12-step wizard.
sections.faq:
Is it only for weddings?

No. It is optimized for weddings but can be used for any type of celebration or event.
